title: Banners
description: Manage and approve store promotional banners.

list.emptyStateDesc: There are no banners matching your current filters.
list.errorState: Error loading banners. Please try again.

details.notFoundDesc: The requested banner could not be found or has been deleted.

approve.title: Approve Banner

reject.title: Reject Banner

rejectionReason.label: Rejection Reason
rejectionReason.placeholder: e.g., Image quality is too low...

delete.title: Delete Banner
delete.description: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this banner? This action cannot be undone.
